requirements.label: required
requirements.title: Required Courses
requirements.sourceText: Required Courses - ACC 210 - Financial Accounting 3 credits; ACC 214 - Managerial Cost Analysis and Applications 3 credits; ACC 310 - Intermediate Accounting I 3 credits; ACC 311 - Federal Income Taxation I 3 credits; ACC 400 - External Auditing 3 credits

requirements.label: elective
requirements.title: Upper-division accounting elective
requirements.sourceText: Choose one upper-division accounting elective from the list below: ACC 301 - Governmental & Not-for-Profit Accounting and Reporting 3 credits; ACC 313 - Intermediate Accounting II 3 credits; ACC 320 - Artificial Intelligence in Accounting and Assurance 3 credits; ACC 401 - Intermediate Managerial Accounting & Data Analytics 3 credits; ACC 403 - Accounting Information Systems 3 credits

requirements.label: transfer
requirements.title: Transfer credit limit

rule.text: Students may apply a maximum of nine transfer credits toward the Accounting Minor.
rule.reason: No rule type expresses a program-wide cap on transfer credits toward a minor

requirements.sourceText: Transfer Credit Policy: Students may apply a maximum of nine transfer credits toward the Accounting Minor.

policies.sourceText: All courses must be taken for a letter grade and passed with a grade of C or higher.

notes.text: Students may apply to the accounting minor at any time during their academic career provided that their cumulative grade point average is 3.20 or higher.
Non-business majors may complete the accounting minor.
Completion of the minor requires 18 credits.
